basic_details.job_title: National CAMPA Assistant Inspector General of Forests Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (National CAMPA) has announced 2 vacancies for the Assistant Inspector General of Forests post on a deputation basis, with a tenure not exceeding five years. Applications can be submitted by email from 13 October 2026 to 25 November 2026. Eligible IFS officers who have completed the mandatory cooling off period and are clear from the vigilance angle must fill Part-I of the application form, get Part-II filled and signed by the concerned State/UT Government, and send the complete application along with vigilance clearanc

qualification.details: Eligible candidates must be Indian Forest Service (IFS) officers. Applicants must have completed their mandatory cooling-off period, be clear from the vigilance angle, and have no disciplinary proceedings pending where charge sheets have been served. The appointment is made on a deputation basis for a period not exceeding five years, in accordance with the provisions laid down in the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016, and CAF Rules, 2018.

selection_process: Selection for appointment on deputation is conducted under the non-Central Staffing Scheme of the Ministry of Environment
and concurrence of the State or UT Government.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Complete applications must be sent by email to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must be Indian Forest Service (IFS) officers. Applicants must have completed their mandatory cooling-off period, be clear from the vigilance angle, and have no disciplinary proceedings pending where charge sheets have been served. The appointment is made on a deputation basis for a period not exceeding five years, in accordance with the provisions laid down in the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016, and CAF Rules, 2018.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Part-I of the application form filled by the applicant Part-II of the application form filled and signed by the concerned State/UT Government State Government's Vigilance Clearance Original or duly attested APARs for the last eight years Updated Executive Record Sheet

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for appointment on deputation is conducted under the non-Central Staffing Scheme of the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change, based on eligibility, completion of the cooling-off period, vigilance clearance, and concurrence of the State or UT Government.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Inspector General of Forests post?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Assistant Inspector General of Forests post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application by email is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for this deputation?
faq.answer: Eligible and willing Indian Forest Service (IFS) officers who have completed their mandatory cooling-off period and are clear from the vigilance angle can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum tenure for this deputation posting?
faq.answer: The deputation period will not exceed five years.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the selected officers be posted?
faq.answer: The selected officers will be posted at Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the email address to send the application?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Are there any application fees required?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose Part-I and Part-II of the application form, State Government vigilance clearance, attested APARs of the last eight years, and an updated Executive Record Sheet.
